run_boostbuild_dependency_test: run the BoostBuild test that verifies correct handling of dependencies on generated sources and from generated sources
test_header_scan_dependency_chain: test that the build system correctly scans header includes and errors when a transitive header dependency is missing
test_build_order_with_mkcorder: test that generated header files are created before targets that depend on them using mk_correct_order_func
test_multiple_targets_shared_dependency: test that when multiple targets depend on a generated source with missing headers, all are skipped correctly
test_locate_and_search_directories: test that LOCATE and SEARCH directives work correctly with HDRSCAN and HDRRULE for indirect header dependencies
